ChromePing

Phone calls, handled

# Never make a phone call you're dreading again.

Type what you need done. Your ChromePing agent dials the number, says it is calling for you, handles the call in their language, and sends you the outcome: the time, the reference number, what they said.

ChromePing is a browser calling service on a monthly plan. On Plus and Pro an AI agent makes phone calls for you: it rings the number, tells the other person it is an AI calling on your behalf, holds the conversation in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch or English, and reports back in writing. On every plan you can also dial any phone in the world from your browser yourself, with live two-way translation and captions. The person called needs nothing, not even internet. [...] Rings out or busy? The attempt uses none of your minutes.
 ### A written report, every time

  In your language, in the app and in your inbox.

The second door

## Or make the call yourself and understand every word.

Dial any phone in the world from your browser on your plan's minutes. Don't share a language? ChromePing translates the call live, in both directions, with captions. You speak your language. They hear theirs. All they do is answer their phone.

### Type the number, then choose who calls

Send the agent with a sentence on what needs doing and what it may agree to, or ring the number yourself. Either way the other person just answers their phone.

### Read the report, or talk with captions

The agent's call ends in a written report: outcome, time, reference, what they said. Your own call runs with live translation and captions, both languages on screen.

Calling someone who speaks your language? Skip the translation. ChromePing works just as well as a plain international calling service.
